name: SenseNova-SI-1.1-InternVL3-8B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from OpenGVLab/InternVL3-8B (config.json max_position_embeddings 32768). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A spatial-reasoning SFT of OpenGVLab/InternVL3-8B, identical tensor set and config (28 layers, 3584 hidden, 32768 context). Recorded because the card prints a model column and the InternVL3-8B base column in one HTML table across five spatial benchmarks, and it wins all five - the MindCube-Tiny gap (85.6 vs 41.5) is the largest single-benchmark gain in this batch. Card prose says 50.1 on SITE while its own table says 47.7; the table number is recorded. Caveat: 1.1 is not the current release (the card points at 1.2), and all five benchmarks are spatial-intelligence suites, so this is a targeted capability rather than a general VLM gain. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2025-11-11.
